errors.cardNeedsText: A card needs a title or a description.
errors.faviconNeedsSvg: A favicon is rendered from SVG markup or an SVG file.
errors.fontFilesEmpty: Fonts for "{{name}}" are an empty list. Pass at least one font file, or a fontsource family.
errors.fontNotInstalled: Font "{{family}}" has no files for weights {{weights}}. Install it: npm install @fontsource/{{family}}.
errors.iconNotFound: Icon "{{file}}" was not found. A package path needs its package installed.
errors.imageNotSupported: Image "{{file}}" is in a format ogier cannot draw. Use an SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
errors.liteFontNeedsFiles: Font "{{family}}" is a fontsource family, which ogier/lite cannot read. Pass font files for every role, or import from ogier.
errors.liteImageNeedsData: Image "{{file}}" is a file, which ogier/lite cannot read. Pass it as svg or data, or import from ogier.
errors.pagesShareImage: Pages "{{first}}" and "{{second}}" both write the card image "{{file}}". Rename one of them.
errors.webpInPng: Image "{{file}}" is WebP, which the PNG renderer cannot draw. Convert it to PNG or JPEG, or use renderSvg.
